DEMO — fictional candidate

Compass shows team leads where routing delays begin, and routing is where I have done my most useful work. At Acme Corp I cut first response time from 8 minutes to under 3 by redesigning ticket routing.

Northwind says its design priority is helping leads correct queue problems before customers need to follow up. I want to run a support team at a company whose product is built around the problem I have spent my best work on. Leading your 10-person team would let me apply what I learned on routing, with a product designed to show where it breaks.
